title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1982-05-22
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC>AIFF>Final Cut>WAV>FLAC)

ai_review.summary: Phenomenal matrix recording that puts you in the Greek venue, though the set omits “Deal”.
ai_review.review: The matrix capture of this 1982 show is praised as immersive and crystal‑clear, ranking it among the best recordings of a Grateful Dead Greek gig. Listeners love the sound quality, but one reviewer notes that “Deal” never appears in the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are five‑star and highlight exceptional matrix sound; the only drawback is a missing song, which does not heavily impact overall enjoyment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, immersive audio that feels like being inside the building with the band; repeatedly called one of the best matrix recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on pacing or transitions; reviewers focused on sound quality and noted the absence of “Deal”.
